generation.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one premium mobile landscape 16:9 full-screen gameplay concept for Chinese hand-painted 2D prison escape puzzle game 《这次怎么逃》, preferably 1920×1080.
Input image1: current actual cafeteria gameplay STYLE/material/scale reference only. Input image2: current cell/workshop actual gameplay STYLE/camera/character reference only. Input image3: approved A09 paper HUD art language reference, not its old bottom-card/backpack layout or clock/deadline rules. Generate a NEW joystick-oriented layout.
Output ONE actual game-screen concept, no phone shell, presentation board, diagram arrows, external margin, big game title, webpage header, white sidebar, author signature or watermark. Prison world must fill all four edges. Crisp legible Simplified Chinese typography and painted game art, professionally unified, restrained—not generic black/gold fantasy or glossy RPG UI.

WORLD: nearly top-down 2D orthographic camera, horizontal/vertical pale warm low stone walls and worn gray-green flagstone floor, iron barred cells on left, warm ochre wood workshop benches on right. Charming hand-painted comic sprites standing upright, existing proportions. Broad open central corridor; a locked barred door at center-left and a clear passage towards right. THREE friendly orange-uniform inmates, clear identity: #1 slim messy black hair; #2 round/bald, selected; #3 square brown side-part hair, NO cap, NO new outfit. Exactly one navy-uniform guard. Selected #2 stands at the locked gate around middle of screen with small teal selection ring, tiny number2 badge and small lock target indicator. #1 stands a few steps away distracting the guard with a small speech bubble and clear small status label "交谈中"; guard turned toward #1, small subdued facing cone. #3 separately works at a right-side wooden bench with small gear/hammer activity icon and short label "工作中". Do not invent fight/HP/weapon attack systems, chained characters, extra allies, giant area circles or food mechanics. Camera enough overhead that all three actions and traversable route are visible, avoid HUD covering the selected character, conversation pair, work station or unique door.

HUD COLOR/FINISH: compact floating rounded paper cards in warm cream/ivory, muted sage-gray ink outlines, soft tiny shadows, dark ink text, teal selection, ochre nutrition accents. Mostly peripheral, not large opaque slabs. Full-screen world remains readable. A slightly translucent spacious thumb-zone joystick, visually refined pencil/paint circle, modest arrows/central disc, no mechanical sci-fi rings.

EXACT LAYOUT:
- TOP LEFT within comfortable24px edge safe inset: one compact cream time card, large "10:56" plus "劳动", small line "第1天 · 剩余2天21:04". Small clock/calendar icon and compact "日常表" entry on its right side. No long numeric timeline needing fake clock dots, no22:00 deadline.
- TOP RIGHT: three compact chips "逃脱 0/3", coin icon+"24", pause icon. Directly BELOW: a small map card roughly200x140 at1920 canvas scale (max13%screenwidth), little schematic room plan, teal friendly points, red guard point, tiny camera frame, one location/crosshair corner control; no giant map overlay. The controls should be genuinely finger-friendly in final design, not microscopic.
- LEFT LOWER QUADRANT: exactly THREE COMPACT partner cards SIDE BY SIDE above the joystick, total span about28%screenwidth. Each card is taller than a tiny portrait icon but no more than180 high at1920width. It must clearly contain correct portrait, number, one short skill label, a short activity/state, and TWO thin explicitly named bars "体力" and "饱腹" (teal and ochre). These are stamina/nutrition, NOT combat health. Card1 skill "会聊天", status "交谈中"; Card2 skill "会撬锁", status "控制中", prominent teal border/check; Card3 skill "会收纳", status "工作中". No large text paragraphs. Skill is random loadout independent of portrait identity. Keep all three easy to tap and compact, no tall full-width bottom dock.
- BOTTOM LEFT below those cards, separated by clear gap: one joystick centered around x8%y84%, diameter~160px at1920w. Cream/translucent circular outer pad with sage contour, teal central thumb disc offset gently right. It controls ONLY selected inmate2. No left camera edge-scroll arrows and no second joystick. Keep joystick away from cards by at least16px. World shows through its translucent center.
- BOTTOM RIGHT, thumb reachable, near x90%y83%: ONE main round/rounded cream button~130px diameter with key/lock pictogram and exact text "撬锁", meaning context interaction available at nearby locked door. Teal rim for availability, no radial combat skill wheel. Above/left of it, TWO smaller60-80px buttons distinctly separated: skill pictogram text "技能", backpack pictogram text "背包". Bag button tiny "0/1" since selected #2 has no backpack expansion; NO extra item-slot grid. Buttons are at least16px apart, not visually overlapping. No joystick on right.
- LOW CENTER between thumb zones: a narrow low contrast floating paper hint "切换伙伴，不中断聊天与工作". Avoid covering the gate/paths, keep far enough above bottom gesture edge. No permanent controls manual.

COMPOSITION PRIORITY: selected lockpick at center-left, chatting inmate+guard near middle, working inmate to right—all away from thumb HUD. HUD edges should be within24px safe inset, bottom items above32px gesture-safe inset. Design for MOBILE TOUCH: readable medium Chinese labels, generous hit targets, clear partner selection versus continuing activities. This is a polished game screenshot concept, not explanatory graphic. All provided exact Chinese text must be correct. Preserve palette/style from references while allowing new clean joystick HUD arrangement.

targeted_edit.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Refine this exact mobile game UI concept only, preserving every scene location, full-screen 16:9 composition, Chinese text, joystick, three cards, palette, UI style, selected inmate2, locked gate, map and ongoing activities. Three localized fixes only: (1) inmate3 at the workbench and his card portrait MUST have NO CAP/HAT, replace brown cap with his established bare brown side-part hair, square jaw and friendly broad face, keep orange prison clothes and working pose unchanged; do not change number/skill labels. (2) separate right thumb buttons: move the small backpack/skill row about25px higher so there is at least20px visible clear gap between the bottoms of both auxiliary circular buttons and the top of the large teal lockpick button; keep the main button and its text 撬锁 unchanged and safe margin to bottom/right. (3) guard is facing chatting inmate1 on his LEFT, so remove the large yellow light cone projecting to the RIGHT and replace with a very subtle short faint amber cone pointing LEFT toward inmate1; keep guard sprite position and speech/status unchanged. No new characters, buttons, bars, text or mechanics. Every existing correct Chinese label must remain letter-for-letter correct. Only the above local edits, no redesign and no identity change for inmates1/2.
